items.description_zh: 一个高性能的通用机器人工具包，面向多种机器人任务，集成了逆运动学、模型预测控制、运动规划、优化、强化学习与机器人仿真等模块。
items.highlight_zh: 哨兵运动规划与决策 RL 仿真训练

rm.usage: 可作为哨兵/工程机械臂运动规划与MPC控制的通用算法参考库，比如借用其规划与优化模块搭建底盘路径或机械臂轨迹原型；但它未在RM场地、机载算力和传感器条件下验证，需自行改造并做实时性测试，不能当作现成参赛系统。

recommendation.reason_zh: 运动规划、机器人控制的可迁移方法或工具；近一年有代码更新
recommendation.limitations_zh: 通用方法需在RM场地、传感器与算力条件下验证，不能视为可直接参赛的完整系统

items.name: PX4-Autopilot
items.description_en: PX4 Autopilot Software
items.description_zh: PX4 开源飞控软件栈，支持自主飞行、避障与 DDS 通信，广泛用于无人机与无人车平台。
items.highlight_zh: 飞控底层，可搭空中机器人/哨兵平台

rm.usage: 可借鉴其多旋翼姿态/位置控制、offboard 指令接口与局部避障框架，用于空中机器人稳定悬停、自动起降的底层控制思路；赛场无GPS，须换成室内定位且在飞行段与机库只能用可见光链路，不能直接搬用其GPS/Wi-Fi组网条件，也不可直接参赛。

items.name: mmdetection
items.description_en: OpenMMLab Detection Toolbox and Benchmark
items.description_zh: OpenMMLab 出品的检测工具箱与基准库，基于 PyTorch 集成 Faster R-CNN、YOLO、DETR、RTMDet 等大量目标检测与分割模型，配套完善训练评测流程。

rm.usage: 用其检测框架（RTMDet/RT-DETR等）训练装甲板点阵屏、能量机关灯臂的检测器，并作为模型量化部署的起点；需自建赛季数据集与跟踪/弹道闭环，本身不是自瞄或能量机关算法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 检测与目标跟踪的可迁移方法或工具；至少两年历史，具有可查询的公开关注度或引用证据

items.name: OpenVLC
items.description_en: OpenVLC is an open-source and open-hardware, flexible, and low-cost Visible Light Communication platform.
items.description_zh: OpenVLC 是一个开源软硬件、灵活且低成本的可见光通信（VLC）平台，提供 LED 收发所需的硬件设计与驱动代码，便于研究者搭建并验证可见光通信链路。
items.highlight_zh: 可用于机器人间 LED 光通信链路的原型验证
items.readme_excerpt: This is the repository for the OpenVLC platform, an open-source, flexible and low-cost Visible Light Communication System platform. **OpenVLC1.3 driver:** software defined MAC and PHY layer (implemented as Linux driver) and firmware (to control the programmable real time units of the BBB (PRU)) In OpenVLC, the VLC interface is set up as a new communication interface that can take advantage of the vast range of Linux tools. This,and the new receiver design allow us to increase the transmission frequency to 1 MHz and, thus, the communication rate. One cape can work as Transmitter (TX) or Receiver (RX). To emulate a transmission with OpenVLC 1.3 you can produce in the cape pin TX SIGNAL (P8_45 in BBB) a square wave between 0 and 3.3 V at 1 MHz. Modulated light can be measured with a fast light-sensing device (photodiode) connected to an oscilloscope. This will boot up the PRUs with the code necessary to transmit and receive VLC data. ## What is Visible Light Communication - LiFi? Visible Light Communication (VLC), sometimes also referred to as “LiFi", uses standard off-the-shelf visible light LEDs to transmit data using the visible light spectrum.

optical_review.reason_zh: 这是作者持续演进的低成本开放可见光平台，含嵌入式物理层、网络驱动和硬件说明，可参考调制、同步、收发调度及抗环境光设计。
optical_review.limitations_zh: 当前README主要说明1.3版的光电二极管、ADC和PRU路线，与2015论文的早期LED探测实现不同；依赖BeagleBone及对应硬件，移植到MCU和轻型机需重新评估体积、功耗、视场和照度。
optical_review.license_note: 作者README区分驱动GPL-3.0和PRU代码BSD-2；各子目录许可需分别遵守。

rm.usage: 面向可见光通信的完整开源平台，可参考其光电二极管接收前端、嵌入式物理层调制解调、同步与抗环境光设计，用于机库与空中机器人之间的下行/上行链路原型；当前实现绑定 BeagleBone+ADC，移植到轻型机需重估体积、功耗、视场与照度合规（S24 的 300Lux 限值）。

items.highlight_zh: 事件相机高速信标识别，可用于自瞄快速目标跟踪
items.readme_excerpt:
# Smart Visual Beacons with Asynchronous Optical Communications using Event Cameras

These sensor characteristics are ideally suited to enable visual target tracking in concert with a broadcast visual communication channel for smart visual beacons with applications in distributed robotics. We quantitatively evaluate the relationship between LED transmission rate, communication distance and the message transmission accuracy for the smart visual beacon communication system that we prototyped. The proposed method achieves up to 4 kbps in an indoor environment and lossless transmission over a distance of 100 meters, at a transmission rate of 500 bps, in full sunlight, demonstrating the potential of the technology in an outdoor environment. ## Citation If you use or discuss our algorithm or datasets, please cite our paper as follows:
